name: Treasure Scent (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School divination; Level bard 3, inquisitor 3, druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hour/level

DESCRIPTION

You gain a sense of all treasure within 30 feet of you. You can sense copper, silver, gold, platinum and gems. Each different type of treasure has a different feel for you and you can easily differentiate the scents .

You do not know the exact location of the treasure when you first detect it but you know the general direction and the power of it (determined by the volume of that treasure). If you come within 5 feet of the treasure, you know its exact location. This sense can penetrate barriers but 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of (non-treasure) metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks the sense.
